column1: # Python adapter manifest — the layer BELOW the JS ecosystem. Unbrowse ships a
# zero-edit drop-in (HTTP clients) or native-tool adapter (agent SDKs) for the
# most-used Python libraries, in the upstream's own surface, attributing them.
# Chosen by adoption research (June 2026): requests (~30M/wk, dominant), httpx
# (HTTP/2, sync+async), aiohttp (async standard), urllib3 (low-level base many
# clients sit on); crewai (~5M/mo PyPI, top Python agent fw) and pydantic-ai
# A row is GREEN (scripts/python-adapter-gate.sh) only when ALL of:
#   ATTR  its README names the upstream (upstream_pypi)
#   TEST  `python3 <test>` exits 0 (the upstream's surface is provided)
# columns:  upstream_pypi <TAB> unbrowse_pkg <TAB> pkg_dir <TAB> readme <TAB> test
